title: ab hayaate deene paighambar ka saamaa'n hogaya
body:
ab hayaate deene paighambar ka saamaa'n hogaya
leejiye pura dile shabbar ka armaa'n hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
qasime gul pairahan har rang me hai laa jawaab
sal'e shabbar jange shabbiri ka unwaa'n hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
baaghe paighambar me qaasim agaye misle bahaar
ab sukoone qaatire zainab ka saamaa'n hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
hogayi haasil use kuch maarefat sibtain ki
hazrate qasim ka jis insaa'n ko irfaa'n hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
jo imaamat ka chaman tha jo risalat ka bahaar
maqsade shabbir par wo phool qurbaa'n hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
wo na samjha tha ke pota bhi ali ka hai ali
azme hyder dekh kar arzaq pareshaa'n hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
shafiye mehshar ke dil ka ek tukda ye bhi hai
meri baqshish ka yaqeenan aaj samaa'n paida hua
